svg.title: The AI Champions Network
svg.desc: Two loops meet at AI Champions, one to two per business unit. In the top-down loop the adoption team and IT train and support champions, and champions surface best practices back to the adoption team. In the bottom-up loop champions provide peer coaching to colleagues, and colleagues' questions and feedback flow back to champions.
svg.text: Champions connect top-down enablement with bottom-up adoption.
THE ROLE THIS SECTION IS ABOUT
